description.id: Memasukkan makanan atau minuman dengan sengaja pada waktu puasa membatalkan puasa; lupa diperlakukan berbeda dalam fikih.
description.en: Deliberately consuming food or drink during fasting hours invalidates the fast; forgetfulness is treated differently in jurisprudence.

description.id: Hubungan seksual dengan sengaja pada waktu puasa membatalkan puasa dan dapat menimbulkan kewajiban tambahan menurut kasusnya.
description.en: Intentional sexual intercourse during fasting hours invalidates the fast and may entail additional duties depending on the case.

description.id: Ejakulasi yang sengaja ditimbulkan membatalkan puasa menurut pandangan umum; rincian sebab dan akibat hukumnya berbeda menurut mazhab.
description.en: Deliberately induced ejaculation invalidates the fast under the general view; details of cause and legal consequence differ among schools.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for school-specific rulings

description.id: Datangnya haid atau nifas menghentikan keabsahan puasa hari itu; hari Ramadan yang terlewat diganti sesuai ketentuan.
description.en: The onset of menstruation or postpartum bleeding ends the validity of that day's fast; missed Ramadan days are made up as prescribed.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for detailed rulings

description.id: Muntah yang sengaja ditimbulkan dipandang membatalkan oleh mayoritas; muntah tanpa sengaja dan rincian batasannya mengikuti mazhab.
description.en: Intentionally induced vomiting is considered invalidating by the majority; involuntary vomiting and its limits follow school-specific rulings.

sources: Consult a competent local religious authority for school-specific rulings

description.id: Obat oral membatalkan puasa. Hukum suntikan, infus, inhaler, tetes, dan prosedur lain bergantung sifat asupan dan pendapat lembaga fikih; konsultasikan kasus nyata.
description.en: Oral medicine invalidates the fast. Rulings on injections, infusions, inhalers, drops, and other procedures depend on their nature and juristic-body guidance; seek case-specific advice.

sources: International Islamic Fiqh Academy, Resolution No. 93 (1/10) on substances that break the fast
